yaml.description: Braintrust run on the fixed_size_sampled slice: 80.0% accuracy, top confusion pairs.

markdown.markdown:
**Experiment ID:** main-1785360515
**Link:** <https://www.braintrust.dev/app/UW-Madison-DSHB/*p*/AMFAM-Doc-Classification/experiments/main-1785360515>
**Dataset:** Braintrust dataset `fixed_size_sampled` (project `DSHB_amfam_capstone_2026`), images pulled from row attachments
**Prompt:** `CLASSIFICATION_PROMPT` from `src/openrouter_classifier.py`
**Settings:** `max_tokens=1024`, `temperature=0.1`, `reasoning.effort=medium`, `max_concurrency=8`

### Results

| Metric | Value |
| -------- | ------: |
| **Accuracy (exact_match)** | **80.00%** (128/160 correct) |
| Prompt tokens (avg) | 1,713 |
| Completion tokens (avg) | 302 |
| Completion reasoning tokens (avg) | 300 |
| Total tokens (avg) | 2,015 |
| LLM duration (avg) | 4.34s |
| Errors | 0 |

### Per-class accuracy

| Class | Correct |
| ------- | --------: |
| advertisement | 10/10 (100%) |
| email | 10/10 (100%) |
| file_folder | 10/10 (100%) |
| memo | 10/10 (100%) |
| handwritten | 9/10 (90%) |
| letter | 9/10 (90%) |
| resume | 9/10 (90%) |
| scientific_publication | 9/10 (90%) |
| specification | 9/10 (90%) |
| news_article | 8/10 (80%) |
| scientific_report | 8/10 (80%) |
| budget | 6/10 (60%) |
| invoice | 6/10 (60%) |
| questionnaire | 6/10 (60%) |
| presentation | 5/10 (50%) |
| form | 4/10 (40%) |

### Top confusions (expected → predicted)

| Expected | Predicted | Count |
| ---------- | ----------- | ------: |
| invoice | budget | 4 |
| presentation | file_folder | 3 |
| form | budget | 2 |
| news_article | scientific_publication | 2 |

The remaining 21 misclassifications are singletons spread across `budget`, `form`,
`questionnaire`, `presentation`, and the `scientific_*` pair.

### Notes

- Dataset holds 166 rows; 6 are placeholder rows with no stored image attachment and are skipped, leaving 160 labeled images.
- `invoice` ↔ `budget` remains the dominant confusion despite the disambiguation rules; checks and statements of account are still read as invoices and vice versa.
- `form` is the weakest class (40%) — mostly absorbed by `budget`, `specification`, and the `scientific_*` classes.
- Braintrust rejected part of this run's log batches (`num_scores_calendar_months` quota, 11,005/11,000), so the experiment in the UI contains fewer rows than the 160 scored locally.
